plugin.name: Bend2
plugin.description:
Language support for Bend 2 in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Syntax highlighting, hash line comments, and editable snippets
  • Completion, parameter information, parameter hints, constructor-case generation, and explicit imports
  • Go to Declaration, Go to Symbol, Find Usages, static dependency inspection, and source Quick Documentation
  • Manual and optional background compiler checking of unsaved source and imports
  • Selectable proof roots, law/fill navigation, proof progress, Run and Build configurations
  • Foreign source paths, previewable file refactoring, templates, and optional IDE spelling assistance
Editing works without a Bend installation. Configure a Bend compiler to use checking and compiler-backed features. See the README for setup and current limitations.
plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.1.20:

  • Speed up switching between laws and candidate proofs by caching bounded source-link inventories. Revalidate source and loading inputs, reject canceled or inconsistent captures, and release cached sources when the project closes.
  • Navigate Quick Documentation Declaration and Implementation links to their source file and offset instead of reloading the documentation page; stale links stay inside IDEA without navigating.
